

效果，

spread

{
    config:{
        n: 0 //数量
        pitch: [0,0],
        yaw: [0,0],
        t: [0,0],
        v: 0,
        g: 0,
        cmdv: [{}],
        tick_cmdv: [{}],
    }
}


firework

{
    config:{
        life: 0,
        colors: {
            from:[I;],
            to:[I;]
        },
        shape: 0,
        trail: 0,
        twinkle: 0,
        n: 0,
        tags: []
    }
}

示例：
/execute positioned -661.00 23.95 -516.38 run function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/spread 
{
    config:{
        n:30,
        cmdv:[{
            cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/firework",
            args:{config:{
                shape:0,
                colors:[{from:[I;13047173],to:[I;16761035]},{from:[I;16766720],to:[I;16777184]}],
                n:1
            }}
        }],
        tick_cmdv:[{cmd:"particle end_rod ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force"}],
        v:0.5,
        g:0.01
    }
}


launch

{
    config:{
        life:0,
        cmdv:[{}],
    }
}


示例：







function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/launch {
    config:{
        life:30,
        cmdv:[
            {cmd:"playsound minecraft:entity.firework_rocket.large_blast ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 1000"},
            {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/spread",
            args:{config:{
                n:30,
                v:0.5,
                g:0.01,
                tick_cmdv:[{cmd:"particle end_rod ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force"}],
                cmdv:[
                    {cmd:"summon pig ~ ~ ~ {CustomName:\"猪猪\",CustomNameVisible:true}"},
                    {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/firework",
                    args:{config:{
                    shape:0,
                    colors:[{from:[I;13047173],to:[I;16761035]},{from:[I;16766720],to:[I;16777184]}],
                    n:1
                }}}]
        }}}]
    }
}


function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/launch {
    config:{
        life:50,
        cmdv:[
            {cmd:"playsound minecraft:entity.firework_rocket.large_blast ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 1000"},
            {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
            {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
            {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
            {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
            {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/spread",
            args:{config:{
                n:30,
                v:0.5,
                g:0.01,
                tick_cmdv:[{cmd:"particle flame ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force"}],
                cmdv:[
                    {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/firework",
                    args:{config:{
                    shape:0,
                    colors:[{from:[I;13047173],to:[I;16761035]},{from:[I;16711680],to:[I;10824234]}],
                    n:1
                }}}]
        }}}]
    }
}


function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/launch {
    config:{
        life:30,
        cmdv:[
            {cmd:"playsound minecraft:entity.firework_rocket.large_blast ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 1000"},
            {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/spread",
            args:{config:{
                t:[40,70],
                n:6,
                v:1,
                g:0.02,
                tick_cmdv:[{cmd:"particle dragon_breath ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force"}],
                cmdv:[
                    {cmd:"playsound minecraft:entity.firework_rocket.large_blast ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 1000"},
                    {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
                    {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/spread",
                    args:{config:{
                        n:30,
                        v:0.5,
                        g:0.01,
                        tick_cmdv:[{cmd:"particle flame ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force"}],
                        cmdv:[
                            {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/firework",
                            args:{config:{
                            shape:0,
                            twinkle: 1,
                            colors:[{from:[I;13047173],to:[I;16761035]},{from:[I;16766720],to:[I;16777184]}],
                            n:1
                        }}}]
                }}}]
        }}}]
    }
}

                    colors:[{from:[I;13047173],to:[I;16761035]},{from:[I;16711680],to:[I;10824234]}],
                    n:1
                }}}]
        }}}]
    }

function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/launch {
    config:{
        life:50,
        cmdv:[
            {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
            {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
            {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
            {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/spread",
            args:{config:{
                pitch:[-180,180],
                yaw:[-90,90],
                n:400,
                v:0.8,
                g:0.001,
                tick_cmdv:[{cmd:"particle end_rod ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force"}],
                cmdv:[
                    {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
                    {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/firework",
                    args:{config:{
                    life:1,
                    shape:0,
                    colors:[{from:[I;16776960],to:[I;8421376]},{from:[I;16747520],to:[I;13789470]}],
                    n:1
                }}}]
        }}}]
    }
}

        life:30,
        cmdv:[
            {cmd:"playsound minecraft:entity.firework_rocket.large_blast ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 1000"},
            {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/spread",
            args:{config:{
                t:[40,70],
                n:6,
                v:1,
                g:0.02,
                tick_cmdv:[{cmd:"particle end_rod ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force"}],
                cmdv:[
                    {cmd:"playsound minecraft:entity.firework_rocket.large_blast ambient @a ~ ~ ~ 1000"},
                    {cmd:"summon tnt ~ ~ ~"},
                    {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/spread",
                    args:{config:{
                        n:30,
                        v:0.5,
                        g:0.01,
                        tick_cmdv:[{cmd:"particle end_rod ~ ~ ~ 0 0 0 0 1 force"}],
                        cmdv:[
                            {cmd:"function fimel_sklibs:skfirework/fx/firework",
                            args:{config:{
                            life:1,
                            shape:0,
                            twinkle: 1,
                            colors:[{from:[I;16776960],to:[I;8421376]},{from:[I;16747520],to:[I;13789470]}],
                            n:1
                        }}}]
                }}}]
        }}}]
    }
